title: Customer region declaration and rollback playbook
content:
Purpose and scope:
This is a lightweight operator + product playbook for when a customer declares a region preference (pin) and for executing a safe rollback if needed. Intended audience: product managers, solutions engineering, on-call operators, and legal/CS leads.

Context / background:
- Customers may request a hard or soft region pin for compliance, latency locality, or contractual reasons.
- We currently support pin modes: soft (affinity), hard (enforced), and hybrid (anchor + burst).
- This doc focuses on the operational steps after a customer declaration, validation checks before enforcement, telemetry to observe impact, communication templates, and a clear rollback procedure.

Quick decision matrix (high level):
- If customer requests pin for legal/regulatory requirement -> follow "strict enforcement" flow and involve Legal (escalate).
- If customer requests pin for latency/ops -> follow "soft/hybrid" default and run a 72-hour staging validation.
- If any enforcement causes >5% error rate increase or >2x tail-latency for customer SLA routes -> trigger rollback.

Checklist: pre-enforcement verification (owner: SE + Customer Success)
- Confirm signed SOW / contract clause referencing region residency (linked artifact).
- Verify customer tenancy metadata: tenant-id, account owner, billing org, default region.
- Validate KMS key location requirements with Security (kms-check ticket).
- Run customer-specific simulation in staging (see section: "Staging runbook").
- Confirm backup plan: ability to route to fallback compute pool in case of outage.
- Inform SRE and Oncall (ping #residency-ops + create short-lived incident channel).
- Create monitoring dashboard snapshot and baseline metrics (latency, error-rate, prefix-cache-hit, token-cost).

Staging runbook (low friction):
1. Create a simulated tenant in the pinned region with identical traffic pattern (use synthetic scenario used in JIRA-3477).
2. Enable pin in soft mode for 48–72 hours. Collect: 95/99 latency, 5xx counts, KV cache hit ratio, model fallbacks.
3. Run A/B comparison against current unpinned baseline for at least 24 hours of peak traffic.
4. Document perf delta and escalate if tail latency increases >30% or 5xx > baseline + 0.5%.

Enforcement steps (hard pin):
- T-24h: Notify customer (template below) and internal stakeholders; schedule maintenance window if required.
- T-4h: Ensure telemetry pipeline is green (ingestion lag < 20s).
- T-2h: Snapshot configuration and routing table; record commit id and operator name.
- T: Apply pin policy to tenant via control-plane CLI: redwood pin set --tenant <id> --mode hard --region <code> --evidence-id <id>
- Post-T+15m: Validate route sampling (sample 100 requests) to confirm locality assertion.
- Post-T+1h: Verify dashboards and run smoke checks (chat generation for 5 sample prompts).
- Post-T+24h: Consolidate telemetry and prepare customer report.

Rollback triggers (automatic/manual):
Automatic triggers (monitoring hooks):
- Error rate spike >2x baseline sustained for 10m.
- P95 latency degradation >2x baseline for 10m.
- Critical infra alerts (node OOM, network partition affecting pinned region).
Manual triggers:
- Customer reports failed functionality or unacceptable UX (CS escalation).
- Legal escalates based on emergent compliance contradictions.

Rollback play (operator steps):
1. Immediately set pin to soft/fallback mode: redwood pin update --tenant <id> --mode soft --reason "rollback: automatic trigger"
2. Re-route critical traffic to fallback region using Fast Path (instructions in CONFLUENCE: Fast-Path-ReRoute-Guide).
3. Re-run 100-sample verification to assert reduced error rate.
4. Create a post-rollback incident (if not already) in JIRA with observability snapshots attached.
5. Notify customer and internal stakeholders using rollback template.
6. If rollback fails or state is inconsistent, escalate to SRE and Engineering runbook owners (pager).

Evidence collection and auditability:
- Always capture: control-plane commit id, operator uname, timestamp, and evidence bundle (routing snapshot, sampling traces, config diff).
- Store evidence in the tenant audit bucket with a short description: s3://residency-evidence/<tenant-id>/<YYYYMMDD>-<action>.tar.gz
- For legal-sensitive pins, ensure HSM/KMS policy proof is attached (kms-proof.pdf).

Communication templates (copy/paste):
- Enforcement notice (to customer):
Subject: Region pin enforcement scheduled for <date/time>
Hi <Customer-Name>,
We will apply the region pin to <region> at <time>. Expected impact: none for normal traffic; we will monitor for 24 hours and share a report. If you have maintenance restrictions please reply by <time>.
Thanks,
Customer Success

- Rollback notification (to customer):
Subject: Region pin rollback executed for <tenant-id>
Hi <Customer-Name>,
We detected increased errors after enforcing the region pin and performed a rollback at <time> to restore service. Our next steps: investigating root cause + a follow-up postmortem by <date>. Apologies for the disruption. Please share any immediate concerns.
Regards,
Customer Success + Product

Operator quick commands (cheat sheet):
- View pin: redwood pin describe --tenant <id>
- Update pin: redwood pin update --tenant <id> --mode <soft|hard> --region <code> --note "..."
- Snapshot routes: redwood routes snapshot --tenant <id> --out /tmp/<id>-snapshot.json

Telemetry to examine (minimum):
- customer.routes.p95
- customer.routes.5xx_rate
- customer.kv_cache.hit_ratio
- control_plane.apply_latency
- model.variant_fallback_rate
- billing.token_cost_delta

Risk matrix (summary):
- Low risk: latency neutral, small customers, soft pin.
- Medium risk: medium traffic, hybrid pin, cross-region KMS dependency.
- High risk: enterprise SLAs, hard pin, dependent on region-specific connectors (on-prem connectors).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who signs off final "evidence bundle" for legal audits? (currently: Legal + Customer Success TBD).
- Add automated pre-flight checks (billing-tag validity, kv-ttl compatibility). JIRA-4602
- Bake a one-click rollback in Console (UX brief needed).

Notes to self / rough ops ideas:
- We should capture short sample transcripts on enforcement to detect hallucination regressions tied to quantization changes in region-specific infra.
- Consider a "grace warmup" where we route 10% traffic to pinned region for 2h before full cutover. Low risk and useful signal.

Attachments & references:
- Confluence: region-pin-guide (link above)
- JIRA: JIRA-4521 (customer onboarding), JIRA-4602 (automation), JIRA-3477 (staging-scenarios)
- Slack: #residency-ops threads (search: "<tenant-id> pin request")

Appendix: sample postmortem checklist (for when rollback occurred)
- Collect all traces spanning T-30m to T+60m.
- Export control-plane commit and config diffs.
- Interview operator and oncall (notes in PMR).
- Include customer impact table (requests lost, errors returned).
- Propose mitigations and timeline for re-enforcement (if requested).

-- end --

Drafted by: Priya Nair (product), version notes: initial draft for review by SE + SRE.
